query: Research concrete feasibility gaps for Numera Wiz, a nearly all-Rust desktop/browser GUI + CLI/MCP wrapper around native FFmpeg. Browser runs same egui UI against local engine; Windows portable EXE, Linux/macOS supported. FFmpeg-only media operations, GPU Auto with CPU-only mode. Builds/tests in CI; owner-local GPU validation. Inspect primary docs/source, including https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft and https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft (GUI/effect donors), https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.html and ffmpeg-filters.html, official MCP specifications/Rust SDK, browser WASM/MSE security docs. Focus on: FFmpeg midstream filtergraph reinitialization and temporal state; preview color/alpha agreement between native RGBA and browser H264/MSE; temporal echo/time offsets relative to prior effects and retiming; safe pre-probe admission for manifests/external references (protocol whitelist vs filesystem scope); CSP/MIME needed for Rust WASM/MSE; bounded agent image/audio observations and large artifact transfer; FilmCraft shortcut registration/headless parity; sequence FPS/canvas changes and unknown future project data. At most 10 significant findings with exact source URLs, source evidence separate from recommended selected design, practical acceptance tests and remaining uncertainty. Avoid generic feature lists, unsupported performance promises or pretending tests were run. Current candidate pins are FFmpeg 9.0.2 commit 946fcce07b6dcd0331c8cc609192aeff5e1924f8, FilmCraft d643a886650bfbf16f24762274054575aa1e8f20, EffectCraft 9db7f3b21700fd821f215782ed1c82afe077880f; verify if accessible. Read-only public-source research, no login or external writes.
